get.summary: Every unit of measure with its usage, smallest unit first.
Entries of a list whose name in any language contains the search text, with usage counts.

post.summary: Adds an entry, or returns the existing entry with the same name.

get.summary: Parties whose name contains the search text, optionally of one kind, with source and holder counts.

post.summary: Adds a party, or returns the existing party with the same name.
Uploads an .xlsx workbook and starts reading it in the background.

get.summary: The catalogue fields a workbook column can be mapped to.
The tables of words parsing reads (month names, currency words, measurement labels, spellings of the inch), built-in entries with the user's.

put.summary: Replaces the user entries of a table; none puts the table back to the built-in entries.

get.summary: The detectors a line rule can recognise lines with: the built-in ones and the user's own.

post.summary: Saves a user detector: a pattern with named captures (value, remainder, item) or a list of keywords.
Runs a detector definition against sample lines without saving anything, for live feedback while editing.

put.summary: Changes a user detector. Built-in detectors cannot be changed.

delete.summary: Deletes a user detector that no template or unfinished import uses.

post.summary: Copies a user detector under a new name.
Evaluates the first rows with an unsaved mapping.

get.summary: The workbook's collection group, dynasty, storage location and party texts with their decisions.
The texts of one kind (dates, dimensions) the import cannot settle by rule, with their rows and decisions.
The stored queries: system queries first, then user queries by name.

post.summary: Saves a user query. The document must hold one query operation that is valid against the GraphQL schema.

get.summary: What a query builder may offer: the roots, the fields of every type, the fields a list can be filtered and ordered on with their operators, the enums and the limits, read from the running schema.

post.summary: Describes a document without storing it: the type of every value it returns and of its variables, or its problems with line and column.

put.summary: Renames a user query and/or replaces its document. System queries cannot be changed.

get.summary: The type of every value the query returns, by path, and of its variables, so bindings can be checked.

post.summary: Copies any stored query, system queries included, into a new user query.

get.summary: The stored pages: system pages first, then user pages by name. With navigation=true, only the pages shown in navigation.

post.summary: Saves a user page. The definition must have the shape of a page and name only stored queries that exist.

put.summary: Changes a user page; values left out are kept. System pages cannot be changed.

get.summary: A page by the slug in its address.

post.summary: Copies any stored page, system pages included, into a new user page.
